payload.goal: Close the repo-memory gap: the doctor's repo-memory axis observes repo-generality only from decisions cited across initiatives, so operational knowledge that is not a decision — the npm publish command and its failure modes, found missing 2026-08-04 — has no capture path and no detector. Nothing complains when such knowledge lives only in an agent's private memory. Decide a mechanism that stays inside the observed-not-declared premise of record-graph and does not revive the rejected scope:repo|initiative field.
